method: Manual public-page review, 2026-10-03: one company-published page per entity, read in an ordinary browser or fetched; looked for a sentence naming the legal entity (ideally with its FRA licence number). established = the company's own page names the FRA licensee; verified = the company's own page ties the brand to the FRA-registered group/name without naming the exact licensee; lead = no such page found (reason recorded). No sign-in, no form submission, no file downloads.
